text: Another important concept for school
finance is fund [music] balance. Think
of it like the district savings account.
PPS aims to keep between 5 and 10% of
annual expenditures [music] in reserve.
This reserve is a safety net. It helps
cover emergencies or unexpected costs,
but it's not [music] meant to cover
ongoing expenses. Any amount above 5%
can sometimes be used to support
operations, [music]
but only on a one-time basis. it can't
sustain long-term needs. Beginning in
232 24, [music] PPS started using some
of this fund balance to preserve staff
and programs instead of making deeper
cuts. Now, after several years of this
[music] practice, PPS has reached a
minimum fund balance with no reserve
left for future use. This is why a
careful long-term planning [music] is
critical. Using savings for day-to-day
costs is not sustainable, and that's the
situation we're working to address now.
